'''Alvin Robert Lamar Jones III''' (born September 9, 1978) is a Luxembourgish-American<ref>[http://www.eurobasket.com/player.asp?Cntry=BUL&PlayerID=12713 Alvin Jones profile], ''eurobasket.com''</ref> former professional [[basketball]] player. A {{convert|6|ft|11|in|m|adj=on}}, {{convert|265|lb|kg|adj=on}} [[center (basketball)|center]], he attended [[Kathleen High School]] in [[Lakeland, Florida]],<ref name=draftprofile>[http://www.nba.com/draft2001/playerfiles/alvin_jones.html Alvin Jones NBA Draft 2001 profile]</ref> and played collegiately at the [[Georgia Institute of Technology]], where he set the program's all-time record for shots blocked with 425.<ref name=draftprofile/>

Jones was drafted by the [[Philadelphia 76ers]] with the 56th overall pick of the [[2001 NBA draft]]. He played one [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) season ([[2001-02 NBA season|2001–02]]), averaging 1.1 points and 1.6 rebounds in 23 games. His final NBA game was Game 5 of the 2002 Eastern Conference First Round against the [[Boston Celtics]] where the 76ers lost the game 87–120. Jones recorded 1 rebound and 1 turnover in 4 minutes of playing time and the 76ers were eliminated from the playoffs 4–1.

In 2006, he played with German team [[Köln 99ers|RheinEnergie]].<ref>[http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/5660/180/rheinenergie-releases-alvin-jones?smid=277 RheinEnergie releases Alvin Jones]</ref>
